bayts.text: Praise belongs to God, who requites those who have done good with good and with triumph.
And may His blessings be upon the Tihāmī (Muḥammad, the Prophet of Tihāma), upon his Family and his Companions, his servants.
That said, today I am filled with contentment and filled with love for these (my disciples).
Therefore I said, asking the Generous (Allah) for their recompense, by the rank of him (Muḥammad) who possesses the mighty rank:
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord! O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Beloved!
Bless the best of creation, Muḥammad, his Family and, with them, the Companions devoted to worship.
Forgive my sins and the sins of the Muslim men and Muslim women, O All-Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr), O Helper (Al-Muʿīn).
Fulfil the needs of those who have persevered in my service, and grant them what they have longed for.
Grant them faith (al-īmān) and submission (al-islām), spiritual opening (al-fatḥ), excellence (al-iḥsān) and complete surrender to You.
Requite them on my behalf with forgiveness, with wondrous graces (al-karāmāt) and with Your good pleasure.
Draw them towards right guidance and good, and turn them away from perdition and harm.
Forgive them every idle word and every sin, and grant them, all together, purity of heart.
Be their Helper in the affairs of religion and of this world, throughout the course of the ages.
Do not take them to account for the offences they have committed, in secret and in the open, for You are the Most Generous (Al-Akram).
Grant them in the sciences an opening (fatḥ) that removes from them every impurity and every ugliness.
Grant them a happiness that endures, O Kind (Al-Barr), O Answerer of prayers (Al-Mujīb), O Generous (Al-Karīm).
Turn their hearts towards acts of obedience, through knowledge and through action, at all times,
by the rank of the most excellent of creation, Muḥammad, and by the sanctity of the most glorious month of Ramaḍān,
and by the sanctity of his Family and all his Companions, and by the sanctity of every obedient worshipper.
Pour forth Your blessing upon him (Muḥammad), then Your peace, upon his Family and his Companions, and honour them,
for as long as service (to the Prophet) remains a ladder to happiness, salvation and exaltation.
